post.headline: *Stop* losing real‑estate leads overnight
post.subline: Automate WhatsApp replies and schedule showings in seconds, so no prospect slips away
post.caption:
⏰ Leads vanish the moment they’re captured – and every missed follow‑up costs you a commission. 
🔧 Fix: Deploy an AI bot that instantly replies to new inquiries on WhatsApp, qualifies interest, and books a viewing in your calendar. 
💡 Today: Set up a simple Zap that forwards every new lead from your website form to a WhatsApp template message – you’ll see responses jump 3x. 
Save this post and share it with any agent who needs to stop losing deals. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call
post.insight_note: Real‑estate agents are losing commissions due to slow manual follow‑up, a pain point perfect for instant AI messaging.
